verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents Broadcasts that send a message to a defined list of recipients, queued for a time you specify. Composition is covered by a drag-and-drop visual editor, a code editor and Design Studio, and audience targeting by Segments. A community user corroborates that building, editing and previewing emails felt straightforward. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of choosing a segment as a broadcast's audience in the UI, detailed send-now vs. schedule workflow documentation, and independent corroboration of the scheduling step.
